summary: Reliance Global Group agreed to sell its wholly owned subsidiary Southwestern Montana Insurance Center to Scali, LLC (dba Scali Insurance Group) under a September 1, 2026 equity-and-asset Purchase and Contribution Agreement. Consideration is $2,625,000 cash at closing, an 8.75x multiple of $300,000 pro forma EBITDA, plus uncapped additional consideration of 8.75x any EBITDA above $300,000 for the twelve months ending August 31, 2027, subordinated and due within 90 days thereafter. Closing is escrowed pending buyer's full cash payment by September 11, 2026; non-compete and employment conditions apply.
